description:
How far residents went at school and the highest qualification they hold since: Year 12 to Year 8 or below, and postgraduate, bachelor, diploma and certificate levels, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,500 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/education`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_left_school, year_12_count, year_12_pct, year_11_count, year_11_pct, year_10_count, year_10_pct, year_9_count, year_9_pct, year_8_or_below_count, year_8_or_below_pct, did_not_go_to_school_count, did_not_go_to_school_pct, school_not_stated_count, school_not_stated_pct, total_aged_15_plus, bachelor_or_higher_count, bachelor_or_higher_pct, postgraduate_degree_count, postgraduate_degree_pct, graduate_diploma_or_certificate_count, graduate_diploma_or_certificate_pct, bachelor_degree_count, bachelor_degree_pct, advanced_diploma_or_diploma_count, advanced_diploma_or_diploma_pct, certificate_count, certificate_pct, certificate_3_or_4_count, certificate_3_or_4_pct, certificate_1_or_2_count, certificate_1_or_2_pct, certificate_level_unspecified_count, certificate_level_unspecified_pct, qualification_inadequately_described_count, qualification_inadequately_described_pct, qualification_level_not_stated_count, qualification_level_not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

lga_name.description: Council (LGA) name exactly as /v1/lga/list returns it, e.g. `Lake Macquarie`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: lga_area_stats_education
